# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.13-beta

Public updater portability repair.

## Fixed

- existing runtime stop/start scripts are invoked through `sh`, so an older installation no longer needs execute bits to be set correctly before update;
- rollback also uses shell invocation for historical runtime scripts;
- the updater health check no longer depends on host-side `/root/moonraker-env/bin/python3`;
- backend readiness is verified with the Z-Mod-provided `wget` against the local `/api/health` endpoint;
- existing-runtime install handoff invokes the updater through `sh`;
- added a regression scenario reproducing a real public AD5X failure: non-executable old runtime scripts and no host Moonraker Python.

## Field failure addressed

The previous public update could reach:

```
.../ifs_spoolman/stop.sh: Permission denied
AD5X IFS Plugin for Spoolman: Moonraker Python not found: /root/moonraker-env/bin/python3
AD5X IFS Plugin for Spoolman: rollback.
```

Those host-specific assumptions are removed from the generic update path.

Native Fluidd compatibility remains:

- Sergey Fluidd: `v1.37.7`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`
